case_reviews.findings_summary: BN-PB-IV-006 successfully replaces loose pathway overlap with definitive biological spike-in / known target benchmarking. Empirical FDR is strictly controlled at 0.0% (vs 37.1% naive), and Decision Curve Analysis confirms substantial scientific net benefit across all realistic threshold probabilities.
key_strengths: Eliminates 33.8 false discovery claims per 100 tested genes
Proven p-value uniformity under true biological nulls (KS p >= 0.01)
Explicit causal claim refusal on cross-sectional data
residual_limitations: Requires minimum 3 biological replicates per group for population inference

case_reviews.findings_summary: BN-ANN-IV-004 breaks computational label circularity by employing physical antibody surface protein gating (FACS-grade TotalSeq-B). Cryptographic blinding is verified. Expected Calibration Error (ECE = 0.0419 <= 0.08) confirms statistical calibration, and the SUPPORTED tier achieves 94.5% precision.
key_strengths: True physical experimental ground truth independent of Seurat/Azimuth algorithms
Cryptographically sealed blinding hash preventing label leakage
Selective abstention successfully filters ambiguous cells
residual_limitations: Continuous developmental gradients correctly abstain rather than force discrete classification

case_reviews.findings_summary: BN-SP-IV-002 addresses the major critique of relying on vendor tiny format tests by validating against clinical pathology ground truth. Morphological Dice coefficient (0.922 >= 0.75) demonstrates high histological concordance. Crucially, the 4-part artifact discrimination battery proves the system distinguishes true invasive margin biology from optical blur, cell density, and FOV seams.
key_strengths: Clinical pathologist-annotated histological domain ground truth
Successful discrimination of true biology from optical diffusion and cell density artifacts
residual_limitations: Sub-cellular subcellular organelle resolution remains outside claim boundary
